_readme: Cosmos House, the second half of the two-house fixture for developing and testing the
cleaning team's app. The first half is scripts/cleaning-fixture-lotus.example.json,
and the README section on this app has the commands that turn the pair into one merged
documents file.
Every code and every phone number below is invented and none of them opens or reaches
anything. The personal door codes are the same digits as the Lotus House fixture's
because the skill holds them on the roster and not on the property: its own words are
that they are per person and identical across every property. Only the gate code is the
house's. A fixture that gave one person two different door codes would be describing a
payload shape that does not exist.
The address is the house's own, copied from the Address row of
as-operations/properties/pending_36ChangKhlan/36ChangKhlan-property-profile.md in the
document store. The map link is derived from it and from nothing else.
The id is the house's website slug rather than a Beds24 property id, because Cosmos
House has no Beds24 room: the site lists it for enquiry only. Lotus House's id is its
Beds24 property id for the same reason, which is that in both cases it is the key the
venture already uses for that house. Whatever the id is, it has to be stable: a screen
tells two houses apart by it.
The queue titles are Latin placeholders in square brackets. A house name is Paul's to
write and a fixture is not where Thai gets written, which is the rule the older fixture
carries too.
The jobs are built to exercise what the screens now do, not to look plausible:
- 18/11 and 22/11 collide with Lotus House jobs, so one day holds two houses
- 22/11 at 09.30 and 18/11 at 10.00 fall earlier than the Lotus jobs on those days,
so a day whose jobs are ordered by anything but the hour is visibly wrong
- 19/11 and 30/11 are mid-stay, so the occupied mark and the mid-stay line appear
- Da is on both houses on 18/11 and 22/11, and Ting is on every job in both houses
Dates move. Edit the jobs so some of them are in the future, or the whole fixture
renders as a schedule that has already happened.
